# EMS Drone — UAV Components, Customization & System Integration
Configurable UAV supply chain: flight controllers, ESCs, propulsion, airframes, communications, payload and complete aircraft. Engineering support from component sourcing to flight-ready systems.

## Core Pages
- / : Home — UAV supply chain and system integration overview
- /capabilities/ : Component capabilities hub — flight control, ESC, propulsion, airframe, comms, payload
- /capabilities/flight-control/ : Flight controllers — selection, configuration, sensor integration
- /capabilities/esc-power/ : ESC and power systems — speed controllers, distribution, batteries
- /capabilities/propulsion/ : Motors, propellers and powertrain matching
- /capabilities/airframe/ : Frames, structures and platform integration
- /capabilities/communications/ : Radio, telemetry and data links
- /capabilities/payload/ : Cameras, sensors, gimbals and mission kits
- /customization/ : Custom UAV engineering and configuration process
- /testing/ : Tuning, integration checks and testing support
- /industries/ : Industry applications hub
- /industries/inspection/ : Industrial inspection UAV solutions
- /industries/mapping-survey/ : Mapping and survey UAV solutions
- /industries/logistics/ : Logistics and delivery UAV solutions
- /industries/agriculture/ : Agricultural UAV solutions
- /industries/research/ : Research platform UAV solutions
- /about/ : About EMS Drone — engineering approach and team
